mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% for two consecutive months signals central bank over-tightening, which raises real discount rates and dampens equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains above for ≥2 consecutive months
regime_hint: accelerating inflation in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over the 20-day horizon, SPX 20d returns are not statistically different from a baseline of low-inflation periods (t-test p > 0.05); or CPIAUCSL reverts below 0.3% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a single month, the expected future path of discount rates rises, reducing the present value of equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for 60d returns remains positive (>0.05) during the triggered FEDFUNDS move; or 60d returns are not statistically lower than during prior non-hike months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 2,000 jobs for three consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥2,000 over three consecutive months
failure_condition: Over the 5-day horizon, SPX 5d returns are not statistically higher than during prior periods of similar labor strength (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 100 (monthly) accompanied by a simultaneous drop in HOUST below 1,500 units signals weakening manufacturing and retail demand, which compresses earnings growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dual demand contraction in supply-constrained environment
failure_condition: During the triggered cross, SPX 20d returns are not significantly worse than during prior periods of similar dual declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS of at least 50,000 for two months indicates waning consumer spending momentum, which reduces growth prospects and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by ≥50,000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Rank IC for 60d returns during the RSAFS decline is positive (>0.05); or 60d returns are not statistically lower than during prior periods of normal demand deceleration (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.0% for three consecutive months, the expectation of future wage growth declines, lowering the present value of labor-intensive earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns during the UNRATE regime are not statistically lower than during prior periods of similar disinflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent 3-month decline in GDPC1 (real private demand) of at least 2% followed by a stabilization suggests a structural softening in economic activity, which lowers growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls ≥2% for 3 consecutive months then holds
failure_condition: Rank IC for 60d returns during GDPC1 softening is positive (>0.05); or 60d returns are not statistically worse than during prior periods of normal demand moderation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and RSAFS both fall simultaneously by more than 5% in the same month, it indicates simultaneous supply-side shocks (e.g., raw material cost increases and consumer demand softening), which compress earnings and output growth forecasts and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO ↓ >5% AND RSAFS ↓ >5% in the same month
failure_condition: During the triggered month, SPX 20d returns are not statistically lower than during prior periods of similar dual shocks (t-test p > 0.05).
